# Process Metrics

The [Process Exporter](https://github.com/ncabatoff/process-exporter/tree/master) is a custom Prometheus Go package that mines `/proc` on selected resources. In this case, we are only monitoring the `snarkos` process. 
For more information on all metrics exported by this package, click the link.
